items.text: Selected course grades: Demography 12; AI for Humanity: Machine Decisions, Learning and Societal Consequences 10 (Danish seven-point scale).

items.title: Bismarck’s Lost Battle
items.meta: Individual demography course paper · May 2026 · Grade 12
items.text: Marriage, fertility and the Kulturkampf in Prussia, 1867-1890. Historical county-panel analysis using continuous-exposure difference-in-differences. Examines overlapping religious and ethnic policies and limitations to causal interpretation.

items.title: The Danish West Indies
items.meta: Joint MSc thesis · In progress · Supervisor: Paul Sharp
items.text: Economic history of slavery on St. Croix; historical-source analysis, archival data construction and handwriting recognition. With Jonas Skov Nielsen and Sheng Ye Michael Chen. Working title; no final findings claimed.

items.title: Does GenAI Help Those Who Need It Most?
items.meta: Group course research proposal · January 2026 · Course grade 10
items.text: With Jonas Amassa Skov Nielsen and Sheng Ye Michael Chen. Main contributor to the empirical strategy: proposed causal forests and assessment of selection into AI use. Research design only; no collected sample or estimated effects.

items.title: Globalization and the Welfare State
items.text: With Jonas Skov Nielsen and Sheng Ye Michael Chen. Panel-data analysis of globalization and social transfers using fixed effects and rolling regressions.

items.title: Student Lecturer in Excel and VBA
items.text: Teach practical courses; develop exercises and course materials; provide feedback and live problem-solving support.

items.title: Research toolkit
items.text: Panel data, fixed effects, difference-in-differences, identification diagnostics and historical data construction. Software: Python, SAS, Stata, MATLAB, GAMS, Excel and VBA. Languages: Danish (native), English (fluent), German (practical level).
